All defects as found in such periodic inspection report shall be corrected within 90 days after the date of test. An affirmation of correction shall be filed within 14 days of the date of correction.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
